r.d: This is the MS SQL Server MDB2 driver.
r.n:
- PEAR::isError() -> MDB2::isError(), Bug #19491. - PEAR::loadExtension() -> extension_loaded(), Bug #19583. - Fixed boolean type conversion for non-boolean types - Fix Bug #19262. Updates conditional stagements to use logical operators to include MDB2_FETCHMODE_OBJECT where appropriate. Was broken in r321197. - Have truncateTable() return MDB2_OK on success, as documented (bug 19201) - Have dropIndex() return MDB2_OK on success, as documented (bug 19198) - Have vacuum() return MDB2_OK on success, as documented (bug 19196) - Have dropSequence() return MDB2_OK on success, as documented (bug 19191). - FETCHMODE constants are NOT bitwise. - fixed bug #18203: Type introspection breaks with associative arrays if names are identical (patch by Peter Bex)
open todo items: - explore fast limit/offset emulation (Request #4544)
